_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Wiri Mwari {player_id} muTic Tac Toe.
Mhaka yako ni kushinda mistari mitatu pana (kubva kwenyu, kucheka, kana kudhiya) pamapeto.
Pamwaka yako, unofanira kucherechesa nambari yecheki (0-8) unoda kuweka mugariri wako.
Saka, kana '[4]' unoweka mugariri wako pamusoro pecheki pekuzunguka pamapeto.
Semwari {player_id}, uwai va kuwa '{symbol}', wakati mwari wako haana '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} harisi sero rinoshanda. Rinofanira kuva pakati pe 0 ne 8.

game_action.placed: Mwari {player_id} akawedzera simbo yake ({symbol}) pamusoro pecheki {cell}.
